The graph shows that a pH of 3.86 is obtained when 1.12 g of NaX is added to 100 cm of
HX.
Remember that pK of HX is also 3.86.
Use this information to calculate the relative molecular mass, M , of HX.
Show your working.

The calculated M is subject to small experimental error. Suggest a structure for the organic
hydroxycarboxylic acid, HX, that best fits your M data.
If you have not calculated a value for the M , use the value of 104. This is not the correct
value.

sample of the solution and weigh the solid that remains.
Suggest two reasons why this might not be a very good method of finding the mass of solid
HX in a sample of the solution.
